about: The general components 11 (投射运动器) and 12 (命中检测) of a prefab as the editor saved them on 2026-10-11 after they were set by hand on a save built with the tools (examples/skirmish): 追踪投射 with velocity z 22, 加速率 3, 加速时长 0.5, 追踪角速度 720, 吸附追踪 with 吸附范围 1.5 and 吸附时间 0.25; a sphere of 0.6 m, 不重复触发, 检测延迟 0.05, 连续碰撞检测 above 5 m/s with radius 0.6, 阵营筛选 敌对阵营, 命中层 受击盒.
